name: Thila
description: Thila was a small planet in the Thila system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to a major Alliance to Restore the Republic base, Thila Command. The planet had relatively huge mountain ranges, of which the peaks of its gigantic mountains were visible from orbit.
